messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning calendars: pick a 30‑minute intro and ops stakeholder pairing

Hi Elena & Sam,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to hear more about Novara's goals for quicker inference turnaround on clinical search and the constraint around on‑preming PHI. Quick recap + proposed next step:

Recap (2 bullets):
- Main priority: reduce token latency on embed+rank pipeline to sub-200ms p50 for clinical queries; must run in VPC with KMS key controls.
- Success criteria for this phase: 30‑day pilot with sample corpus, latency & cost report, and audit log access for security review.

Next step (30‑minute intro/demo): I recommend a short product intro that covers: product architecture (hosting/dedicated/private options), validation we do for latency & cost, and kickoff checklist for a pilot. To make the session actionable, please pick one of these windows — each includes a suggested internal attendee mix so we can bring the right folks:

Option A — Tue 10/14 10:00–10:30 PT
- Suggested Novara attendees: Elena (product), Sam (platform)
- Redwood attendees: me (AE), Monica (Solution Engineer)

Option B — Wed 10/15 14:00–14:30 PT
- Suggested Novara attendees: Elena (product), (your infra lead if available)
- Redwood attendees: me (AE), Aditya (Security/Compliance)

Option C — Thu 10/16 09:00–09:30 PT
- Suggested Novara attendees: Elena + Engineering manager
- Redwood attendees: me (AE), Monica (SE), Aditya (Security) — we can make this slightly more technical.

Logistics & asks:
- Please reply with the option that works and which Novara attendees will join so we can include the right demos/screens.
- If SOC2 evidence and a short one‑pager would help before the call, I attached both.

Proposed agenda (30m):
1) 5m — goals & constraints
2) 10m — architecture + how we meet latency/KMS requirements
3) 10m — pilot plan & next steps
4) 5m — Q&A / scheduling follow-ups

Thanks — I’ll hold these slots locally until I hear back and will follow up if none of them work.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0149
